mapper.select:
SELECT c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER, ci.CLASS_IMG_CODE) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, ( SELECT ct.NAME FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE ) AS CATEGORY_NAME, '개별일정' AS SCHEDULE_TYPE, c.DESIRED_PRICE, c.WRITE_DATE AS REGISTERED_DATE, ( SELECT MIN(r.OPERATION_START_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_START_DATE, ( SELECT MAX(r.OPERATION_END_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_END_DATE, c.APPROVAL_STATUS, c.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS, c.APPROVAL_MEMO AS REJECTION_REASON FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ( c.APPROVAL_STATUS <> '작성중' OR c.APPROVAL_MEMO IS NOT NULL )
AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}
AND c.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY c.WRITE_DATE DESC, c.CLASS_CODE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS SET APPROVAL_STATUS = '작성중', STATUS = '준비중', REGISTER_STEP = 'basic', WRITE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = '중지' AND STATUS = '대기중'
